## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

[All Early Phase Clinical Services][140]

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

of genetic testing.

# We believe in the power of science to transform our world.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

[Biopharma][240] [Applied Solutions][241] [Food Solutions][242]


# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.

manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

[newsImage]

Cole-Parmer SamplePrep Demo Program

Posted: 1 / 9 / 2025

We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

Our dedicated team of experts and our new demo laboratory are here to assist you in determining the
best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

Our demo lab is equipped with fully operational operational homogenizers (bead beaters), cryogenic
mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results
• Virtual sample processing: virtual demonstration of the equipment and sample processing
• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

After completing the sample processing form, please be sure to schedule your sample processing with
a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

[newsImage]

Cole-Parmer SamplePrep Demo Program

Posted: 1 / 9 / 2025

We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

Our dedicated team of experts and our new demo laboratory are here to assist you in determining the
best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

Our demo lab is equipped with fully operational operational homogenizers (bead beaters), cryogenic
mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results
• Virtual sample processing: virtual demonstration of the equipment and sample processing
• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

After completing the sample processing form, please be sure to schedule your sample processing with
a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

###### About Us

## Mass Spectrometry Experts

Accurate Mass Scientific (AMS) is a proudly Australian, privately owned company dedicated to serving
the expanding mass spectrometry market across Australia, New Zealand, and parts of Southeast Asia.
AMS operates through three specialized divisions. Our technology portfolio represents leading
international manufacturers of cutting-edge mass spectrometry hardware, including advanced
spectrometers, chromatography units, and consumables designed to enhance the performance of existing
instruments and streamline sample preparation. The second division provides high-quality analytical
services and expert consultancy in mass spectrometry. The third division collaborates with Quiet Lab

Founded in 1983, All Eights has established long term partnerships with our local clinical

solutions. We pride ourselves on providing robust technical support to give you peace mind when

## Your Partner
## In Clinical
## Diagnosis

Founded in 1983, All Eights has established long term partnerships with our local clinical
laboratory community and notable manufacturers.

### All Eights Group

##### Reliable Distributor for Medical, Analytical and Laboratory Products

All Eights Group is a company specialising in the distribution of products for Clinical Diagnostic,
Analytical Science and Scientific Equipment
 
Companies looking to expand their business outside their domestic market face many challenges. Our
role is to be their best possible partner, based on our expertise in our market as well as the
network and reach of our existing customer base.
 
With a strong track record, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner.
 
Today, we are present in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.

### Our Focus Areas:

###### Clinical Diagnostics

All Eights serves the clinical diagnostic customers in the field of Hemostasis, Biochemistry,
Immunoassays, Microbiology, Infectious Diseases, Molecular Oncology, Blood Banking, etc…

###### Analytical Science

Our Analytical Science customers span across Biomolecular Processing, Food Safety, Agriculture
Analysis, Industrial Microbiology, Life Science Research, etc…

## Our Sectors

##### Clinical Diagnostic, Analytical Science & Scientific Equipment Distribution

Our network expands across Clinical and Analytical Science. As both markets reach out to different
customers with different needs, we serve our clinical customers through our core company, All
Eights, and the Analytical Science’s customers through our subsidiary, Beacon Sciences.

## Featured Products
* ### [AutEx™ 96 Nucleic Acid Extractor][146]
  
  The Avam® AutEx™ 96 is a revolutionary tool for molecular biology, offering unmatched precision,
  speed, and reliability in PCR applications. Its advanced features, including rapid thermal
  cycling, sophisticated program management, and exceptional temperature control, make it a
  cornerstone for any lab committed to achieving consistent and reproducible results.
  [Select options][147] This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product
  page [Show more][148]
* ### [Avam® NAsafe™ Nucleic Acid Molecular Transport Medium][149]
  
  $201.00 – $245.00Price range: $201.00 through $245.00
  Avam® NAsafe™ is an advanced nucleic acid transport medium designed to collect, inactivate, and
  preserve microbial and human nucleic acids with unparalleled efficiency. Ideal for molecular
  diagnostics, genetics research, and sequencing applications, NAsafe™ ensures sample integrity from
  collection to analysis.
  [Select options][150] This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product
  page [Show more][151]
* ### [DNA VersaKit™][152]
  
  $117.00 – $1,136.00Price range: $117.00 through $1,136.00
  Facilitate streamlined DNA purification with the DNA VersaKit™, compatible with Avam® AutEx™
  platform for automated processing of up to 96 samples, offering rapid and reliable extraction of
  high-quality DNA from various sample types.
  [Select options][153] This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product
  page [Show more][154]

### Avam Sciences

Avam Sciences advances molecular and microbiology technologies, providing high-quality reagents,
consumables, and instruments for research, healthcare, and industry.

### InMicro Laboratories

InMicro specializes in microbiology, offering prepared and dehydrated media, along with essential
lab consumables for microbial testing and quality control.

### Ecose Labs

Ecose focuses on cell culture, delivering optimized media, sera, and consumables for research,
bioprocessing, and therapeutic development.

Bal Seal Engineering’s three core product lines deliver complete solutions for critical
applications. Our [spring-energized seals][64], [canted coil springs][65], and [electrical
connectors][66] share the same advanced spring technology, providing superior performance across
aerospace, medical, and industrial applications.
* [Bal Seal®][67]
* [Bal Spring®][68]

Trusted by engineers and OEMs to protect critical equipment used everywhere, from deep sea to deep
space.

precision sealing applications.

spring technology for superior sealing performance.

Promotes even jacket wear and resists breakdown to extend seal service life by up to 150% over
standard sealing solutions.

Combines custom PTFE polymers, backup elements, and locking rings with wear-regulating spring
energizers to resist extrusion and provide more uptime, less maintenance.

Compensates for large tolerances and surface irregularities, ensuring multi-point electrical contact
for improved reliability, longer equipment life.

Enables accurate control of insertion and removal forces, from just a few ounces to 1000s of pounds.

[Canted coil springs][71] providing consistent force for sealing and mechanical connecting
applications, efficiently managing electrical current in conducting applications, and protecting
sensitive electronics from the harmful effects of electromagnetic interference, or EMI. Performing
across wide temperature ranges.

reduces weight, and even dissipates heat.

Maintains consistent insertion and removal forces over 1000s of cycles. Resists compression set
better than fingerstock, mesh.

 Canted coil spring technology ensures multi-point electrical connectivity and redundant

functional devices.

## Why Engineers Choose Bal Seal Technology

#### [AS 9100D Certified Quality][80]

Every component we make is begins and ends its journey in certified facilities with comprehensive
quality control, ensuring consistent fit, finish, and performance. Whether you need 10 prototypes or
1 million production units, you can be confident that every seal, spring, or contact meets your
strict requirements – and ours.

#### [Measurable Performance Advantages][81]

150% longer service life compared to standard sealing solutions.
Zero leakage performance maintained throughout operational life.
Consistent force and contact pressure as materials naturally wear.
Multi-point electrical reliability compensating for tolerance variations.
Reduced downtime with fewer, more predictable maintenance intervals.

#### [Improved Speed to Market][82]

We deliver our custom seal, spring, or contact proposals in as little as 3 working days, and
functional prototypes in 4-6 weeks. With our combination of engineering and manufacturing expertise,
we help you accelerate your development cycle and avoid costly design pitfalls.

#### [Technical Innovation][83]

Our seals, springs, and contacts don’t just solve engineering challenges; they help you achieve
performance breakthroughs and gain a competitive edge. By making your designs smaller, lighter,
faster, less complex or more robust, our products enable you to focus on technical advancement and
meet evolving user demands.

#### [Mission-Critical Reliability][84]

From Apollo lunar missions to the Mars Perseverance Rover and Ingenuity copter, our seals, springs,
and electrical contacts/connectors have performed flawlessly in the harshest environments
imaginable. This same proven technology protects millions of medical devices and critical defense
systems that simply cannot fail.

#### [Consultative Engineering][85]

When you work with us, you get more than a spring, seal, or contact. You get access to worldwide
technical support and a vast application knowledge base built on nearly 70 years of problem-solving
for medical, aerospace, energy, industrial, and many other industries.

Bal Seal Engineering’s three core product lines deliver complete solutions for critical
applications. Our [spring-energized seals][64], [canted coil springs][65], and [electrical
connectors][66] share the same advanced spring technology, providing superior performance across
aerospace, medical, and industrial applications.
* [Bal Seal®][67]
* [Bal Spring®][68]
* [Bal Contact®][69]


##### Proven

Trusted by engineers and OEMs to protect critical equipment used everywhere, from deep sea to deep
space.


##### Versatile

Delivers superior rotary sealing, reciprocating sealing, oscillating, static, and face sealing
performance across all applications. Custom seal sizes range from 0.020 in. to 120 in. ID for
precision sealing applications.

Custom [spring-energized PTFE seals][70] combining advanced polymer materials with canted coil
spring technology for superior sealing performance.


##### High-performance

Promotes even jacket wear and resists breakdown to extend seal service life by up to 150% over
standard sealing solutions.


##### Predictable

Combines custom PTFE polymers, backup elements, and locking rings with wear-regulating spring
energizers to resist extrusion and provide more uptime, less maintenance.


##### Adaptable

Compensates for large tolerances and surface irregularities, ensuring multi-point electrical contact
for improved reliability, longer equipment life.


##### Precise

Enables accurate control of insertion and removal forces, from just a few ounces to 1000s of pounds.

[Canted coil springs][71] providing consistent force for sealing and mechanical connecting
applications, efficiently managing electrical current in conducting applications, and protecting
sensitive electronics from the harmful effects of electromagnetic interference, or EMI. Performing
across wide temperature ranges.


##### Multi-functional

Mechanically connects, conducts current, grounds, and shields against EMI/RFI. Simplifies designs,
reduces weight, and even dissipates heat.


##### Robust

Maintains consistent insertion and removal forces over 1000s of cycles. Resists compression set
better than fingerstock, mesh.


##### Ultra-Reliable

 Canted coil spring technology ensures multi-point electrical connectivity and redundant
power/signal paths. Compensates for tolerance variations and exhibits extremely low contact
resistance throughout operational life.


##### Compact

Employs springs from 0.5mm (.020 in) and housings with pitch of ~2mm.  Supports smaller, more
functional devices.

[Spring-loaded electrical connectors][72] that employ canted coil spring technology for reliable
multi-point connectivity in demanding environments.

## Working With Bal Seal Engineering

## Streamlined Engineering Process

Background Image

## Engage

Our engineers analyze your sealing, connecting, conducting, or EMI shielding requirements for
comprehensive application understanding.

Background Image

## Design

We combine our deep knowledge base with advanced material science to engineer custom seals, springs,
and contacts that elevate your design.

Background Image

## Prototype

Rapid prototyping of custom seals, springs, and electrical connectors in as quickly as two weeks
with comprehensive performance testing.

Background Image

## Produce

AS 9100D certified production scaling from prototypes to millions of seals, springs, and contacts
with rigorous quality control.

## Why Engineers Choose Bal Seal Technology

#### [AS 9100D Certified Quality][80]

Every component we make is begins and ends its journey in certified facilities with comprehensive
quality control, ensuring consistent fit, finish, and performance. Whether you need 10 prototypes or
1 million production units, you can be confident that every seal, spring, or contact meets your
strict requirements – and ours.

#### [Measurable Performance Advantages][81]

150% longer service life compared to standard sealing solutions.
Zero leakage performance maintained throughout operational life.
Consistent force and contact pressure as materials naturally wear.
Multi-point electrical reliability compensating for tolerance variations.
Reduced downtime with fewer, more predictable maintenance intervals.

#### [Improved Speed to Market][82]

We deliver our custom seal, spring, or contact proposals in as little as 3 working days, and
functional prototypes in 4-6 weeks. With our combination of engineering and manufacturing expertise,
we help you accelerate your development cycle and avoid costly design pitfalls.

#### [Technical Innovation][83]

Our seals, springs, and contacts don’t just solve engineering challenges; they help you achieve
performance breakthroughs and gain a competitive edge. By making your designs smaller, lighter,
faster, less complex or more robust, our products enable you to focus on technical advancement and
meet evolving user demands.

#### [Mission-Critical Reliability][84]

From Apollo lunar missions to the Mars Perseverance Rover and Ingenuity copter, our seals, springs,
and electrical contacts/connectors have performed flawlessly in the harshest environments
imaginable. This same proven technology protects millions of medical devices and critical defense
systems that simply cannot fail.

#### [Consultative Engineering][85]

When you work with us, you get more than a spring, seal, or contact. You get access to worldwide
technical support and a vast application knowledge base built on nearly 70 years of problem-solving
for medical, aerospace, energy, industrial, and many other industries.

## Gaserzeugung vor Ort — entwickelt von der BERG Group

Die Gaserzeugung vor Ort erzeugt den industriellen Stickstoff oder Sauerstoff, den Sie benötigen,
direkt an Ihrem Standort. Statt Flüssiggas per Tankwagen oder Gasflaschen über einen Liefervertrag
mit jährlicher Preisanpassung zu beziehen, speisen Sie Druckluft in einen PSA-Generator und erzeugen
das Gas selbst. Betreiber in Lebensmittel- und Getränkeindustrie, Pharmazie, Laboren,
Laserschneiden, Krankenhäusern außerhalb Europas, Aquakultur und vielen weiteren Branchen ersetzen
so ihren Versorgungsvertrag durch eine Anlage, die sich typischerweise in zwei bis drei Jahren
amortisiert.

Berg GaseTech ist die PSA-Technologie- und Fertigungsgesellschaft innerhalb der BERG Group mit
Hauptsitz in Krefeld. In unserer eigenen Produktion entwickeln und bauen wir die NITROBERG®
Stickstoff- und OXYBERG® Sauerstoffgeneratoren. Gemeinsam mit Berg Kompressoren, unserer
Schwestergesellschaft in der Gruppe, liefern wir komplette Systeme — Generator, Druckluftversorgung,
Installation, Inbetriebnahme und weltweiten Service — aus einer Hand.

## Engineering-Substanz und zertifizierte Qualität

Jeder Berg-Generator wird an unserem Standort Krefeld gebaut und geprüft, bevor er die
Produktionshalle verlässt. Wir legen die Anlage auf Ihre Reinheit, Ihren Durchfluss, Ihren Druck und
Ihre Stellfläche aus — nicht auf einen Katalog-Standard. Das Engineering ist direkt erreichbar:
Kommt eine Frage zu Ihrer Anwendung oder Installation auf, sprechen Sie mit dem Team, das Ihren
Generator entwickelt hat — nicht mit einem Routing-Callcenter.

Berg GaseTech ist die PSA-Fertigungsgesellschaft innerhalb der BERG Group. Unsere
Schwestergesellschaft [Berg Kompressoren][86] integriert den Generator in das komplette
Vor-Ort-Gassystem — Druckluftversorgung, Trockner, Filter, Pufferbehälter — und betreibt das
weltweite Servicenetzwerk. Eine Gruppe, zwei Rollen: Technologie und Integration, Seite an Seite.

## Ein weltweiter Partner für die Gaserzeugung vor Ort

NITROBERG® und OXYBERG® Generatoren laufen auf vier Kontinenten — in Lebensmittel- und
Getränkebetrieben, in Massenspektrometrie-Laboren, in Krankenhäusern außerhalb Europas, in
Aquakultur- und Biogasanlagen, in der Metallverarbeitung und im Bergbau. Der Service läuft nicht
über eine einzige zentrale Hotline. Ein regionaler Servicepartner ist Ihr erster Ansprechpartner,
mit einer direkten Engineering-Linie nach Krefeld, wenn eine Anwendungsfrage über den
Standard-Service hinausgeht. Das Modell beruht auf lokaler Präsenz und direktem Engineering-Zugang —
nicht auf einer generischen Anruf-Warteschleife.

Ein typisches Berg-Projekt läuft von der Beratung über die bauseitige Vorbereitung, die
Inbetriebnahme und die Bedienerschulung bis zur langfristigen Wartung. Der Lebenszyklus wird über
Berg Kompressoren als Servicegesellschaft der BERG Group betreut. So bleibt die Engineering-Substanz
in Krefeld und die Integration und der Vor-Ort-Service in Ihrer Region — ein Auftragsumfang und eine
Garantie — keine Zwischenhändlerkette zwischen Ihnen und dem Hersteller.

[N₂- und O₂-Symbol mit Globus als Sinnbild für weltweite Gaserzeugung vor Ort]

## Häufig gestellte Fragen

Was macht Berg GaseTech — und wie hängt das Unternehmen mit Berg Kompressoren zusammen?

Berg GaseTech entwickelt und fertigt PSA Stickstoff- und Sauerstoffgeneratoren — NITROBERG® und
OXYBERG® — in Krefeld. Berg Kompressoren, unsere Schwestergesellschaft in der BERG Group, integriert
diese Generatoren in komplette Vor-Ort-Systeme mit Druckluftversorgung und -aufbereitung und
betreibt das weltweite Servicenetzwerk. Beide Unternehmen teilen sich denselben Hauptsitz und
dasselbe Engineering-Team.

Welche Gase erzeugt Berg vor Ort?

Stickstoff und Sauerstoff, erzeugt per PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption). NITROBERG® liefert
Stickstoff mit 97 % bis 99,999 % Reinheit. OXYBERG® liefert Sauerstoff mit 90 % bis 95 %,
einschließlich in Übereinstimmung mit der European Pharmacopoeia 0937 bei 93 % für medizinische und
pharmazeutische Anwendungen.

Wie schnell amortisiert sich die Gaserzeugung vor Ort gegenüber der Flüssiggas-Versorgung?

Für die meisten Industriestandorte liegt die typische Amortisation bei zwei bis drei Jahren
gegenüber der Tankwagen-Belieferung mit Flüssiggas. Der genaue Wert hängt von Ihrem aktuellen
Vertragsvolumen, der geforderten Reinheit und den Betriebsstunden ab. Unser Anwendungs-Engineering
rechnet den Business Case aus Ihren tatsächlichen Verbrauchsdaten — nicht aus einer generischen
ROI-Annahme.

Sind die Verschleißteile proprietär, oder sind sie frei am Markt verfügbar?

Standard. Filter und Verschleißteile sind Standardware vom freien Markt. Nach dem Kauf besteht keine
Abhängigkeit von einem proprietären Lieferanten — Ihre Servicekosten bleiben planbar, und Ihr
Engineering-Team ist nicht an eine einzige Quelle gebunden.

Wohin liefert Berg, und wie funktioniert der Service außerhalb Deutschlands?

Berg-Generatoren sind weltweit installiert. Lokale Servicepartner übernehmen Inbetriebnahme,
Schulung und Vor-Ort-Service in den meisten Märkten, mit einer direkten Engineering-Linie nach
Krefeld für Anwendungs- und Konstruktionsfragen. Der Service wird über Berg Kompressoren als
Integrations- und Servicegesellschaft innerhalb der BERG Group erbracht. —

NITROBERG® und OXYBERG® Generatoren laufen auf vier Kontinenten — in Lebensmittel- und

mit einer direkten Engineering-Linie nach Krefeld, wenn eine Anwendungsfrage über den
Standard-Service hinausgeht. Das Modell beruht auf lokaler Präsenz und direktem Engineering-Zugang —
nicht auf einer generischen Anruf-Warteschleife.

Ein typisches Berg-Projekt läuft von der Beratung über die bauseitige Vorbereitung, die
Inbetriebnahme und die Bedienerschulung bis zur langfristigen Wartung. Der Lebenszyklus wird über

in Krefeld und die Integration und der Vor-Ort-Service in Ihrer Region — ein Auftragsumfang und eine

## Häufig gestellte Fragen

Was macht Berg GaseTech — und wie hängt das Unternehmen mit Berg Kompressoren zusammen?

Berg GaseTech entwickelt und fertigt PSA Stickstoff- und Sauerstoffgeneratoren — NITROBERG® und
OXYBERG® — in Krefeld. Berg Kompressoren, unsere Schwestergesellschaft in der BERG Group, integriert
diese Generatoren in komplette Vor-Ort-Systeme mit Druckluftversorgung und -aufbereitung und
betreibt das weltweite Servicenetzwerk. Beide Unternehmen teilen sich denselben Hauptsitz und
dasselbe Engineering-Team.

Welche Gase erzeugt Berg vor Ort?

Stickstoff und Sauerstoff, erzeugt per PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption). NITROBERG® liefert
Stickstoff mit 97 % bis 99,999 % Reinheit. OXYBERG® liefert Sauerstoff mit 90 % bis 95 %,
einschließlich in Übereinstimmung mit der European Pharmacopoeia 0937 bei 93 % für medizinische und
pharmazeutische Anwendungen.

Wie schnell amortisiert sich die Gaserzeugung vor Ort gegenüber der Flüssiggas-Versorgung?

Für die meisten Industriestandorte liegt die typische Amortisation bei zwei bis drei Jahren
gegenüber der Tankwagen-Belieferung mit Flüssiggas. Der genaue Wert hängt von Ihrem aktuellen
Vertragsvolumen, der geforderten Reinheit und den Betriebsstunden ab. Unser Anwendungs-Engineering
rechnet den Business Case aus Ihren tatsächlichen Verbrauchsdaten — nicht aus einer generischen
ROI-Annahme.

Sind die Verschleißteile proprietär, oder sind sie frei am Markt verfügbar?

Standard. Filter und Verschleißteile sind Standardware vom freien Markt. Nach dem Kauf besteht keine
Abhängigkeit von einem proprietären Lieferanten — Ihre Servicekosten bleiben planbar, und Ihr
Engineering-Team ist nicht an eine einzige Quelle gebunden.

Wohin liefert Berg, und wie funktioniert der Service außerhalb Deutschlands?

Berg-Generatoren sind weltweit installiert. Lokale Servicepartner übernehmen Inbetriebnahme,
Schulung und Vor-Ort-Service in den meisten Märkten, mit einer direkten Engineering-Linie nach
Krefeld für Anwendungs- und Konstruktionsfragen. Der Service wird über Berg Kompressoren als
Integrations- und Servicegesellschaft innerhalb der BERG Group erbracht. —

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

# Powering precision medicine into reality

The decoding of the proteome is revolutionizing the way diseases are diagnosed, treated, and
prevented. Biognosys invents and provides patented proteomics solutions at the quality, scale, and
speed required to transform R&D, clinical trials, and clinical decision making.

[OUR STORY][63]

Unbiased biological insights from tissue and biofluids

Novel drug target identification and validation

Custom panels for absolute protein quantification

Biognosys is the world leader in next-generation proteomics contract research services to support
pharma and biotech research and clinical development.

Targeted Proteomics, SpectroMine™ for DDA proteomics, and our free-of-charge QC tool QuiC™.

Our peptide kits and reagents empower researchers to apply cutting-edge proteomics in-house.
Discover our PQ500™ Reference Peptides for plasma proteomics quantification, our iRT kit for quality
control, and our sample preparations kits.

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

[ Explore the Ebola Resource Hub ][207]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[ Explore the 2025 Annual Report ][209]

## Elevating Education Across the Diagnostic Pathway

The newly launched Product Education Hub deepens diagnostic understanding with evidence‑based
resources. Leverage scientific materials, webinars, symposium highlights, case studies, and more to
drive more informed clinical decision‑making.

* ## [ bioMérieux submits 510(k) to U.S. FDA for the latest versions of the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  ## Gastrointestinal Panels to enhance detection of gastrointestinal pathogens ][213]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)
  review. These PCR* molecular panels test 22 and 11, respectively, of the most common bacteria,
  viruses, and parasites associated with gastroenteritis, all from one sample, with results
  available in approximately one hour.
  [ Discover more ][214]
* ## [ Advancing Women’s Health with Rapid Diagnostics: bioMérieux files a Dual 510(k) /CLIA Waiver
  ## application to the FDA for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE® Vaginitis Panel ][215]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, has submitted a Dual 510(k)/CLIA
  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux
  is intending to expand into women’s and sexual health, bringing rapid and accurate diagnostics
  closer to patients.
  [ Discover more ][216]

  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today introduces the launch of
  GENE-UP® TYPER SLM, a new real-time PCR solution supporting rapid root cause analysis by
  discriminating Salmonella in the food industry environments.

# ChemCalc - Molecular Formula Calculator

ChemCalc is a free online tool for mass spectrometry. Calculate molecular weight, monoisotopic mass,
and isotopic distribution from a molecular formula. Find possible molecular formulas from a
monoisotopic mass. Analyze peptide, nucleotide, and polymer fragmentation.

Please enable JavaScript to use the interactive application.

Reference: Patiny L, Borel A. ChemCalc: a building block for tomorrow's chemical infrastructure. J
Chem Inf Model. 2013. DOI: 10.1021/ci300563h

# Molecular formula calculator

Calculate molecular weight, monoisotopic mass, elemental composition, and isotopic distribution from
any molecular formula. Supports groups, charges, salts, and isotope-specific notation for mass
spectrometry.

* [Data for: Hyperspectral sensing to identify Orobanche minor parasitism in red clover][15]
  Prayusha Bhattarai, Iram Mujahid Iqbal, Jing Zhou, Carol Mallory-Smith, Pete Berry
  Mendeley Data | Published 23 July 2026
  This dataset contains hyperspectral reflectance measurements from red clover (Trifolium pratense
  L.) plants, used to detect parasitism by small broomrape (Orobanche minor Sm.). Spectral readings
  were collected post-emergence, after O. minor inflorescences had appeared aboveground, with an ASD
  FieldSpec 4 (Malvern Panalytical, Malvern, United Kingdom) spectroradiometer. The hypothesis was
  that parasitized and non-parasitized red clover plants differ in leaf reflectance, and that these
  differences can be used to discriminate between the two groups using hyperspectral sensing. Data
  collection had two parts. Greenhouse studies (April 2024 and August 2025) involved pots inoculated
  with or without O. minor seed, with spectral readings taken from leaves once O. minor
  inflorescences had emerged aboveground. Field studies (June 2024 and June 2025) took place in two
  red clover seed production fields near Rickreall, Oregon, with known O. minor infestation.
  Parasitized plants were identified by visible inflorescence, and the haustorial connection to the
  host was visually confirmed at excavation. Non-parasitized plants were excavated from the same
  fields as controls. Data were collected at approximately 1,400 growing degree day (GDD) (2024) and
  1,600 GDD (2025), calculated from January 1 with a base temperature of 0°C. Each file contains raw
  reflectance values from 350 to 2500 nm, at 1 nm intervals. Each value is the average of 2–3
  readings taken per leaf sample with the instrument. The dataset covers four groups: 2024
  greenhouse (n = 12 per group), 2025 greenhouse (n = 23 per group), 2024 field (n = 12 per group),
  and 2025 field (n = 10 per group). Plants are identified by sample ID, with treatment and
  treatment code columns marking parasitized versus healthy status. This data was used to visualize
  spectral signatures, run PLS regression on both raw and first-derivative spectra, and calculate
  VIP scores to identify wavelengths associated with post-emergence O. minor parasitism.
  First-derivative models gave classification accuracies between 93.5% and 100% across the four
  groups, with the near-infrared region contributing the most discriminating wavelengths, followed
  by the red-edge, visible, and short-wave infrared regions. To reuse this data, apply
  first-derivative transformation before PLS modeling, since that step improved classification
  accuracy over raw reflectance in every group. Reflectance values below 400 nm and above 2400 nm
  carry more instrument noise and are typically excluded or treated with caution in analysis.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

# Welcome to ESS LTD

European Spectrometry Services are world leaders in mass spectrometry systems.

[Explore][43]

### Bespoke Instruments

We cater to any customer, creating bespoke instruments perfect for your needs and requirements, from
multiple sample points to portable instruments.

[See More][44]

### Maintenance & Repairs

On-site or in-house maintenance and repairs can be provided on all aspects of our instruments to
ensure you always have your mass spectrometer working at its best.

[See More][45]

### Training

1 to 1 or group training is a great way to begin your journey with your new mass spectrometer.
Whether through teams or in person, contact us today to find out more about how we can help.

[See More][46]

## Our Services

### Pharmaceutical

A range of pharmaceutical gas analysis applications.

### Portable

Portable gas analysis. Any time, anywhere.

[Start Now][47]

### Catalyst

Fast and highly accurate catalyst monitoring.

[Start Now][48]

### Environmental

Lead the way in a globally changing economy.

[Start Now][49]

### Plant Safety

Multi-point all time monitoring for worker safety.

[Start Now][50]

### Diving & Pure Gas Mixtures

Ultra high sensitive gas analysis with rapid detection time.

[Start Now][51]

## Our Featured Markets

##### What Sets Us Apart

ESS are first in quality and precision with mass spectrometer manufacturing. Providing for a wide
range of applications in gas analysis and measurement, our customers needs are always exceeded. 
Our high sensitive instrument integrated with a vacuum system yields the fastest gas monitoring
results at the highest precision.

## Have a prescription but not sure which tests to add?

Patients can search the catalog directly, or share prescription details during checkout so the JCRL
team can confirm the right test names before collection.

[Add tests from catalog][52][Email prescription][53]
[Patient handing prescription to a diagnostic care professional]

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

Leadership behind JCRL

## An organisation earns credibility through people, standards, and continuity.

JCRL's direction is shaped by leadership that balances laboratory discipline, operational
seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

[Dr. Simpi Rani, Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics]

“Every diagnostic result carries a duty of care. Our responsibility is to make that process clear,
careful, and professionally accountable.”

### Dr. Simpi Rani

Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics

“A diagnostics network becomes dependable when service, logistics, reporting, and operational
discipline improve together over time.”

[ Funding Call: Applied Energy Research under the 8th Energy Research Programme ][134]
afa-net-basis LLC
Abdullaev Fakhritdin
Offers
We seek to advance SHIELD within the 8th Energy Research Programme (Mission 1: Electricity System
2045). SHIELD is a mechanical resonance system (TRL 3-5) providing instantaneous (<1ms) protection
for critical infrastructure (hospitals, telecom) against power surges in unstable grids. Innovation
& Goals: Technical: Moving from TRL 5 to real-world demonstration. Unlike digital breakers, SHIELD
uses physical resonance to block surges, providing a hardware-level safety layer for volatile grids
with high RES integration. Individual Approach: Each deployment features a custom resonance profile
tailored to local grid impedance—a key R&D focus. Non-Technical: We are validating an ESCO-based
model (payment for results) to lower barriers for infrastructure protection in the Global South,
aligning with German export initiatives. We aim to submit a Project Outline focused on grid
resilience and technology transfer. Please confirm eligibility.

# DNA Testing Services in Kenya – Accurate, Affordable & Reliable

DNA Testing needs not be an expensive, complicated, laborious, or time consuming affair. At KIBS, we
provide reliable, accurate, timely, and affordable DNA tests.

We provide professional DNA testing services in Kenya including paternity tests, prenatal DNA
testing (NIPT), baby gender tests, and genetic screening. Our Nairobi-based laboratory delivers
accurate, fast, and confidential results trusted by families, hospitals, and legal institutions.

[DNA paternity test sample collection in Kenya]
[ DNA Paternity Test in kenya][31]
[Non-invasive prenatal DNA test in Kenya]

## NON-INVASIVE PRENATAL TEST (NIPT)

The Non-Invasive Prenatal Test (NIPT) is a blood test that is conducted in order to determine if the
unborn baby has certain chromosomal and genetic conditions.

Genetic conditions tested include:

Down's Syndrome (Trisomy 21), Edward's Syndrome (Trisomy 18), and Patau's Syndrome (Trisomy 13).

Sex chromosome aneuploidies: Turner syndrome (Monosomy X), Triple X syndrome (Trisomy X),
Klinefelter syndrome (XXY), Jacobs syndrome (XYY), and XXYY syndrome.

Microdeletions: DiGeorge syndrome (22q11.2), 1p36 deletion syndrome, Smith-Magenis syndrome
(17p11.2), and Wolf-Hirschhorn syndrome (4p16.3).

100 monogenic disorders such as sickle cell disease, cystic fibrosis, hemophilia, fragile X, and
many others.

The test is 100% safe to the mother and child and can be done from 10 weeks of pregnancy.

[ NIPT Test in Kenya][32]

## BABY GENDER TEST

The Early baby Gender Test test is safe, non-invasive, and reliable, making it an excellent option
for parents who wish to learn their baby’s gender earlier than is typically possible with
ultrasound.

The DNA gender test determines the sex of the unborn child. It can be conducted from week seven of
pregnancy. Only a sample of the mother’s blood is needed. This means that the mother doesn’t have to
wait until the pregnancy is 20 weeks to determine her baby’s gender through ultrasound. It is more
rleiable and accurate than ultrasound.

[Baby Gender DNA test]
[ Early Gender Reveal Test][33]
[SRY Gender Test]

## SRY Gender Test

The SRY gender test is fast, accurate, and scientifically validated, providing a dependable method
for gender verification when required.

The SRY Gender Test is a DNA-based test used to determine biological sex by detecting the presence
of the SRY gene (Sex-determining Region Y) located on the Y chromosome. This gene plays a key role
in male development. If the SRY gene is detected in a DNA sample, the individual is genetically
male; if it is absent, the individual is genetically female. The test is performed using a simple
DNA sample, such as a cheek swab or blood sample, and provides highly accurate results. Because it
analyzes genetic material directly, the SRY gender test is a reliable method for confirming
biological sex. This test is commonly used in sports and competitive athletics, particularly in
disciplines such as boxing, athletics, and other regulated competitions, where verification of
biological sex may be required for eligibility in male or female categories. It can also be used for
medical, research, or identity verification purposes where confirmation of genetic sex is necessary.

[ SRY Gender Test][34]

## NEWBORN SCREENING

Newborn screening is a simple and important test performed shortly after birth to identify certain
genetic, metabolic, and hormonal conditions that may not be visible at birth but can affect a baby’s
health if left untreated. Early detection allows doctors to start treatment promptly, helping
prevent serious complications and supporting healthy growth and development.

The newborn screening test provides parents and healthcare providers with peace of mind and an early
opportunity to protect a child’s long-term health through timely diagnosis and treatment.

[Newborn screening test sample collection in Kenya]
[ Newborn Screening Test][35]
[inherited disease screening]

## CARRIER SCREENING

By identifying carrier status early, couples can make informed reproductive decisions and discuss
available options with healthcare providers.

The Carrier screening genetic test determines whether an individual carries genes associated with
conditions such as cystic fibrosis, sickle cell disease, and other inherited disorders that could be
passed on to their children. People who carry these mutations are typically healthy and show no
symptoms, but if both parents carry the same genetic mutation, there is a chance their child could
inherit a genetic disorder. Carrier screening is ideal for individuals or couples who are planning a
pregnancy or are already pregnant, helping them understand their risk of passing on specific genetic
conditions.

[ Carrier Screening Test][36]

## KARYOTYPE TEST

The karyotye test looks at your chromosomes to check if they are normal in number and structure and
is used to investigate infertility, repeated miscarriages,and identify conditions such as Downs
Syndrome.

In this test, cells are collected, grown in the lab, and examined under a microscope so the
chromosomes can be clearly seen and arranged in pairs. Karyotyping is commonly used to detect
conditions such as Down syndrome, Turner syndrome, and Klinefelter syndrome. It is also helpful in
investigating infertility, repeated miscarriages, and some types of cancer, especially blood
cancers. During pregnancy, it can be used to check the baby for chromosomal abnormalities. While
karyotyping is a reliable and widely used test in genetic diagnosis and healthcare.

[Karyotype Test in Kenya]
[ Karyotype Test][37]
[SRY Gender Test]

## MONOGENIC DISORDERS TEST

Monogenic disorder test identifies genetic changes on single genes that cause diseases such as
sickle cell anaemia, cystic fibrosis, and Huntington’s disease.

Monogenic disorder testing is a genetic test that looks for changes in a single gene that can cause
an inherited condition. These conditions are passed down from parents to children and include
diseases such as sickle cell anaemia, cystic fibrosis, and Huntington’s disease. The test works by
examining your DNA to identify specific gene changes that may explain symptoms or show your risk of
developing a condition. This type of testing is useful for diagnosing health conditions, confirming
a suspected genetic disorder, or checking if someone is a carrier who can pass the condition to
their children. It can also help guide treatment and family planning decisions. The test usually
requires a simple sample, such as blood or saliva. Results are carefully analyzed by specialists to
ensure accuracy. Monogenic disorder testing provides clear and focused answers, making it an
important tool in modern genetic healthcare.

[ Monogenic Disorder Test][38]
[SRY Gender Test]

## Panel Tests

Panel tests are genetic tests that check a group of related genes at the same time to look for
changes linked to a specific condition such as breast cancer.

Instead of testing one gene at a time, these tests analyze many genes together, making the process
faster and more efficient. They are commonly used for conditions like inherited cancers, heart
diseases, and other genetic disorders where multiple genes may be involved. These tests help doctors
identify the cause of symptoms, confirm a diagnosis, or assess a person’s risk of developing certain
diseases. Panel tests can also guide treatment decisions and help families understand inherited
risks. The test usually requires a simple sample, such as blood or saliva. Results are reviewed by
specialists to ensure they are accurate and meaningful. Panel diagnostic testing provides a
comprehensive and practical approach to genetic testing, helping patients get clear answers more
quickly.

[ Genetic Panel Test][39]

The Early baby Gender Test test is safe, non-invasive, and reliable, making it an excellent option
for parents who wish to learn their baby’s gender earlier than is typically possible with
ultrasound.

The DNA gender test determines the sex of the unborn child. It can be conducted from week seven of
pregnancy. Only a sample of the mother’s blood is needed. This means that the mother doesn’t have to
wait until the pregnancy is 20 weeks to determine her baby’s gender through ultrasound. It is more

## SRY Gender Test

The SRY gender test is fast, accurate, and scientifically validated, providing a dependable method
for gender verification when required.

The SRY Gender Test is a DNA-based test used to determine biological sex by detecting the presence
of the SRY gene (Sex-determining Region Y) located on the Y chromosome. This gene plays a key role
in male development. If the SRY gene is detected in a DNA sample, the individual is genetically
male; if it is absent, the individual is genetically female. The test is performed using a simple
DNA sample, such as a cheek swab or blood sample, and provides highly accurate results. Because it
analyzes genetic material directly, the SRY gender test is a reliable method for confirming
biological sex. This test is commonly used in sports and competitive athletics, particularly in
disciplines such as boxing, athletics, and other regulated competitions, where verification of
biological sex may be required for eligibility in male or female categories. It can also be used for
medical, research, or identity verification purposes where confirmation of genetic sex is necessary.

# DNA Testing Services in Kenya – Accurate, Affordable & Reliable

DNA Testing needs not be an expensive, complicated, laborious, or time consuming affair. At KIBS, we
provide reliable, accurate, timely, and affordable DNA tests.

We provide professional DNA testing services in Kenya including paternity tests, prenatal DNA
testing (NIPT), baby gender tests, and genetic screening. Our Nairobi-based laboratory delivers
accurate, fast, and confidential results trusted by families, hospitals, and legal institutions.

[DNA paternity test sample collection in Kenya]
[ DNA Paternity Test in kenya][31]
[Non-invasive prenatal DNA test in Kenya]

## NON-INVASIVE PRENATAL TEST (NIPT)

The Non-Invasive Prenatal Test (NIPT) is a blood test that is conducted in order to determine if the
unborn baby has certain chromosomal and genetic conditions.

Genetic conditions tested include:

Down's Syndrome (Trisomy 21), Edward's Syndrome (Trisomy 18), and Patau's Syndrome (Trisomy 13).

Sex chromosome aneuploidies: Turner syndrome (Monosomy X), Triple X syndrome (Trisomy X),
Klinefelter syndrome (XXY), Jacobs syndrome (XYY), and XXYY syndrome.

Microdeletions: DiGeorge syndrome (22q11.2), 1p36 deletion syndrome, Smith-Magenis syndrome
(17p11.2), and Wolf-Hirschhorn syndrome (4p16.3).

100 monogenic disorders such as sickle cell disease, cystic fibrosis, hemophilia, fragile X, and
many others.

The test is 100% safe to the mother and child and can be done from 10 weeks of pregnancy.

[ NIPT Test in Kenya][32]

## BABY GENDER TEST

The Early baby Gender Test test is safe, non-invasive, and reliable, making it an excellent option
for parents who wish to learn their baby’s gender earlier than is typically possible with
ultrasound.

The DNA gender test determines the sex of the unborn child. It can be conducted from week seven of
pregnancy. Only a sample of the mother’s blood is needed. This means that the mother doesn’t have to
wait until the pregnancy is 20 weeks to determine her baby’s gender through ultrasound. It is more
rleiable and accurate than ultrasound.

## SRY Gender Test

The SRY gender test is fast, accurate, and scientifically validated, providing a dependable method
for gender verification when required.

The SRY Gender Test is a DNA-based test used to determine biological sex by detecting the presence
of the SRY gene (Sex-determining Region Y) located on the Y chromosome. This gene plays a key role
in male development. If the SRY gene is detected in a DNA sample, the individual is genetically
male; if it is absent, the individual is genetically female. The test is performed using a simple
DNA sample, such as a cheek swab or blood sample, and provides highly accurate results. Because it

biological sex may be required for eligibility in male or female categories. It can also be used for
medical, research, or identity verification purposes where confirmation of genetic sex is necessary.

[ SRY Gender Test][34]

## NEWBORN SCREENING

Newborn screening is a simple and important test performed shortly after birth to identify certain
genetic, metabolic, and hormonal conditions that may not be visible at birth but can affect a baby’s
health if left untreated. Early detection allows doctors to start treatment promptly, helping
prevent serious complications and supporting healthy growth and development.

The newborn screening test provides parents and healthcare providers with peace of mind and an early
opportunity to protect a child’s long-term health through timely diagnosis and treatment.

[Newborn screening test sample collection in Kenya]
[ Newborn Screening Test][35]
[inherited disease screening]

## CARRIER SCREENING

By identifying carrier status early, couples can make informed reproductive decisions and discuss
available options with healthcare providers.

The Carrier screening genetic test determines whether an individual carries genes associated with
conditions such as cystic fibrosis, sickle cell disease, and other inherited disorders that could be
passed on to their children. People who carry these mutations are typically healthy and show no
symptoms, but if both parents carry the same genetic mutation, there is a chance their child could
inherit a genetic disorder. Carrier screening is ideal for individuals or couples who are planning a
pregnancy or are already pregnant, helping them understand their risk of passing on specific genetic
conditions.

[ Carrier Screening Test][36]

## KARYOTYPE TEST

The karyotye test looks at your chromosomes to check if they are normal in number and structure and
is used to investigate infertility, repeated miscarriages,and identify conditions such as Downs
Syndrome.

In this test, cells are collected, grown in the lab, and examined under a microscope so the
chromosomes can be clearly seen and arranged in pairs. Karyotyping is commonly used to detect
conditions such as Down syndrome, Turner syndrome, and Klinefelter syndrome. It is also helpful in
investigating infertility, repeated miscarriages, and some types of cancer, especially blood
cancers. During pregnancy, it can be used to check the baby for chromosomal abnormalities. While
karyotyping is a reliable and widely used test in genetic diagnosis and healthcare.

[Karyotype Test in Kenya]
[ Karyotype Test][37]
[SRY Gender Test]

## MONOGENIC DISORDERS TEST

Monogenic disorder test identifies genetic changes on single genes that cause diseases such as
sickle cell anaemia, cystic fibrosis, and Huntington’s disease.

Monogenic disorder testing is a genetic test that looks for changes in a single gene that can cause
an inherited condition. These conditions are passed down from parents to children and include
diseases such as sickle cell anaemia, cystic fibrosis, and Huntington’s disease. The test works by
examining your DNA to identify specific gene changes that may explain symptoms or show your risk of
developing a condition. This type of testing is useful for diagnosing health conditions, confirming
a suspected genetic disorder, or checking if someone is a carrier who can pass the condition to
their children. It can also help guide treatment and family planning decisions. The test usually
requires a simple sample, such as blood or saliva. Results are carefully analyzed by specialists to
ensure accuracy. Monogenic disorder testing provides clear and focused answers, making it an
important tool in modern genetic healthcare.

[ Monogenic Disorder Test][38]
[SRY Gender Test]

## Panel Tests

Panel tests are genetic tests that check a group of related genes at the same time to look for
changes linked to a specific condition such as breast cancer.

Instead of testing one gene at a time, these tests analyze many genes together, making the process
faster and more efficient. They are commonly used for conditions like inherited cancers, heart
diseases, and other genetic disorders where multiple genes may be involved. These tests help doctors
identify the cause of symptoms, confirm a diagnosis, or assess a person’s risk of developing certain
diseases. Panel tests can also guide treatment decisions and help families understand inherited
risks. The test usually requires a simple sample, such as blood or saliva. Results are reviewed by
specialists to ensure they are accurate and meaningful. Panel diagnostic testing provides a
comprehensive and practical approach to genetic testing, helping patients get clear answers more
quickly.

[ Genetic Panel Test][39]

## Streamlined proteomic services tailored for your business needs, without unnecessary complexity
## or hassle.

## MHC Immunopeptidomics

Immunopeptidomics is the large-scale study of antigenic peptides presented by major
histocompatibility complex (MHC) molecules (also known as human leukocyte antigen, HLA, in humans).
This field plays a crucial role in understanding how the immune system recognizes and responds to
disease, particularly in cancer, infectious diseases, and autoimmune disorders.

MS Bioworks has extensive practical immunopeptidomics experience. Whether you’re seeking guidance on
experimental best practices, custom data analysis solutions, or end-to-end immunopeptidomics
services, we are here to support your projects.

[learn more][15]

## High Resolution Spatial Proteomics

MS Bioworks and Syncell are working together to bring you an industry-first spatial proteomics
service. Get access to high-resolution protein constituent discovery and mapping at a level never
before possible.

[learn more][16]
[[Spatial Proteomics Poster]][17] [[Logos of Syncell & MS Bioworks ]][18]

## Proteome Screening Services

Our deep proteome screening platform integrates state-of-the-art automation, high-resolution
chromatography, Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometry, and advanced data analysis pipelines. The
streamlined workflow enables rapid and reproducible quantification of thousands of proteins across
large sample sets.

[learn more][19]

## OLink^{®} Reveal Plasma Proteomics

High-throughput protein quantification using Next-Generation Sequencing
Quantify ~1,100 biologically relevant proteins from just 4µL of plasma, serum, or other matrices,
with high sensitivity, excellent reproducibility, and minimal hands-on time.

[learn more][20]
[Olink Certified Service Provider]

##### quant-works

### Quantitative Proteomics Services

Quantitative proteomics is a powerful approach for understanding protein dynamics within a cell,
tissue or organism.

[learn more][21]
[data independent acquisition][22]
[Label free][23]
[tmt][24]
[silac][25]
[targeted proteomics][26]

##### ip-works

### Protein Complex Mapping

Ideal for providing a molecular profile of your enriched samples and studying the dynamics of
protein-protein interactions.

[learn more][27]
[IP profiling][28]

##### Protein-works

### Core Facility Services

Protein analysis with mass spectrometry is a core technology for providing routine support to
multiple workflows in the biological sciences.

[learn more][29]
[protein identification][30]
[protein sequence confirmation][31]
[intact mass measurement][32]
[protein profiling][33]

##### ptm-works

### Post-Translational Modification Analysis

services can be used to identify, quantify and localize post-translational modifications on a target
protein or globally across submitted samples.

[learn more][34]

[ptm profiling plus][36]
[phospho-screen][37]
[glyco-screen][38]
[quantitative histone profiling][39]

## Reactive Cysteine Profiling

Reactive cysteine profiling is a powerful and flexible chemical proteomics tool designed to identify
or confirm your drug’s binding site; identify off-target effects; or identify ligandable cysteines
on a protein of interest.

Our reactive cysteine profiling assay leverages advanced high resolution mass spectrometry to
deliver exceptional throughput, sensitivity, and precision, enabling comprehensive detection,
quantification, and characterization of the ligandable cysteinome.

Quality

We provide top-tier Food and Feed Testing, precise Pharmaceuticals Testing, and reliable Analytical
Services to ensure the highest quality and safety standards.

On-Time Delivery

We offer timely Food and Feed Testing, precise Pharmaceuticals Testing, and reliable Analytical
Services to meet your quality and safety needs promptly.


Cost effective

We deliver cost-effective Food and Feed Testing, precise Pharmaceuticals Testing, and reliable
Analytical Services without compromising on quality.

What we do

Neoscience Labs, is analytical laboratory facility in Chennai, Offering testing services in
pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, food. CDSCO approved & NABL accredited.

At our state-of-the-art testing lab, we specialize in comprehensive Food and Feed Testing, precise
Pharmaceuticals Testing, and reliable Analytical Services. Our team of experts utilizes advanced
technology to ensure the highest standards of safety, quality, and compliance for all your testing
needs.

[Food
Testing][30]

Neoscience Labs is a leader in providing comprehensive food testing services to ensure the safety,
quality, and compliance of food products with international standards. Our state-of-the-art
laboratory facilities and experienced team of experts are dedicated to delivering precise and
reliable results.

[Learn more about
food testing services][31]

[Pharmaceutical
Testing][32]

At Neoscience, we are committed to upholding the safety, efficacy, and quality of pharmaceutical
products. Our state-of-the-art laboratories are staffed by a team of highly qualified professionals,
including PhD scientists, experienced chemists, and skilled technicians who work tirelessly to
deliver accurate and reliable results.

[Learn more about
pharmaceutical testing services][33]

[Cosmetics &
Personal Care Testing][34]

Neoscience Labs is at the forefront of providing comprehensive testing services for cosmetics and
personal care products. Our mission is to ensure that your products are safe, effective, and
compliant with international standards.



[Learn more about cosmetic &
personal care testing services][35]

[Specialty
Testing][36]

Neoscience Labs is proud to offer a range of specialized testing services that cater to the evolving
needs of the pharmaceutical and food industries. Our state-of-the-art laboratory is equipped with
advanced technology and staffed by a team of experts committed to delivering precise and reliable
results.

[Learn more about
specialty testing services][37]

[Environmental
Testing][38]

Neoscience Labs is committed to protecting the environment and public health by providing
comprehensive environmental testing services. Our advanced laboratory facilities and expert team are
equipped to analyze a wide range of environmental samples, ensuring compliance with environmental
regulations and standards.

[Learn more about
environmental testing services][39]

[Herbal
Testing][40]

Neoscience Labs is dedicated to ensuring the purity, potency, and safety of herbal products. Our
specialized herbal testing services are designed to meet the needs of manufacturers, suppliers, and
consumers who demand the highest quality in natural health products.


[Learn more about
herbal testing services][41]

We'll guarantee you achieve
optimal outcomes every time.

Our laboratory has pioneered groundbreaking research in chemical analysis and imaging, earning
multiple industry awards and accolades. We consistently push the boundaries of scientific innovation
by innovating with our state-of-the-art equipment and expert team.

version control is built into the platform. We can easily publish new versions as technology and

## Featured protocols

[

editing.

Explore the editor
][10][

### Accelerate research

Dynamic and interactive methods, runnable, precise.

Run a protocol
][11][

### Avoid mistakes

Create and discover reproducible experimental and computational methods with video, reagents,
detailed parameters, and more.

Share reproducible methods
][12]

## protocols.iofor biotechs and pharmaceuticals

Private & secure collaboration w/ HIPAA compliance, audit trail, approval/signature (21 CFR Part
11), 2-factor authentication, encryption, VPC, and more.

[Premium Service for Industry][13]
We have used protocols.io as a resource for our collaborators across the global GenomeTrakr
community. The platform allows users to comment on specific steps, enabling us to identify and track
steps that need clarification or updating. Keeping our protocols current is also easier, since
version control is built into the platform. We can easily publish new versions as technology and
software evolve and improve overtime, while preserving previous versions for method reproducibility.
Ruth E. Timme, Ph.D.
Research Microbiologist at the Office of Regulatory Science, Center for Food Safety and applied
Nutrition, U.S. Food and Drug Administration
[Ruth E. Timme, Ph.D.]
Having a private workspace on protocols.io is indispensable to our biotech. We use it daily to help
with reproducibility and collaboration across our multiple locations.
Dr. Anitha Jakaprakash
CEO, Girihlet
[Dr. Anitha Jakaprakash]

## protocols.iofor universities, nonprofits, and government agencies/labs

A protocols.io Institutional Plan increases productivity, facilitates teaching, improves
collaboration and recordkeeping, and accelerates progress across most research disciplines.

[Premium Service For Institutions][14]
We use protocols.io to share full protocols from our research with other scientists. We appreciate
being able to share full protocols beyond abbreviated methods sections. The versioning of protocols
is especially powerful so that we can identify the exact version of a protocol used in an
experiment, which increases reproducibility.
Dr. Stephen Floor
Assistant Professor, UCSF
[Dr. Stephen Floor]
Our Premium account enables an unlimited number of individuals and groups to use the platform for
private methods. At UCSF, we saw the number of users double and the number of private protocols
almost triple in the first seven months of our membership. We anticipate that this use will
translate into more rigorous and reproducible research methods used by UC researchers.
Anneliese Taylor
Head of Scholarly Communication, UCSF Library
[Anneliese Taylor]
